title: Talk about what happened
name: Simple past events
summary: Learn a few extremely common past-tense chunks.
rule: Conversation commonly uses the perfect tense: habe/bin + past participle. Start by memorizing whole sentences.
examples: Ich bin gestern nach Hause gegangen.
avoid: Motion/change-of-state verbs often use sein: Ich bin gegangen, not Ich habe gegangen.
note: For “was” and “had”, common simple-past forms are ich war / ich hatte.
